status: REAL public-data secondary reanalysis; exploratory, not preregistered
question: Replicated ovarian lesion vs eutopic signatures with adjacent ovarian tissue control

cohorts.pairing_caveat: Matrix pair suffixes preserved; matrix-to-GSM crosswalk not available
cohorts.treatment: No hormonal treatment history per GEO
cohorts.control: Eutopic endometrium of same affected donor; not healthy control

cohorts.scale: Supplied processed VALUE (log2-like range); no second logarithm applied
cohorts.anatomical_control: Lesion-adjacent ovarian tissue from affected donors; not healthy-person ovary
cohorts.cycle_phase: Not resolved by downloaded sample metadata
cohorts.treatment: Not resolved by downloaded sample metadata

excluded.reason: Downloaded metadata lacks per-sample donor/tissue resolution; no guessed pairing

normalisation.array_primary: supplied processed VALUE, canonical gene median

statistical_claim: t-reference results are model-dependent; exact sign-flip sensitivity cannot yield 5% replicated genes with 4 validation donors
limitations: Small n; one cohort has 4 donors only
Bulk tissue composition and organ/site confounding
Adjacent ovary may have a disease field effect and is not a healthy-person control
Secretory untreated discovery cohort; array phase/treatment not resolved in sample metadata
Independence inferred from different original studies/institutions, not direct donor identity matching
t-reference assumes independent approximately normal donor differences
Sign-flip sensitivity assumes sign symmetry; it is not a randomised causal experiment
No batch, age or continuous cycle adjustment beyond within-donor matching
Processed array VALUE scale not fully reconstructed from raw images
Current HGNC mapping may omit retired or ambiguous genes
